source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Your notes skill produces readable summaries but repeatedly omits challenging study questions. You know those questions are essential. What is the best next step?

options.text: Specify the missing requirement and evaluate revised outputs
options.feedback: Your expertise identifies the needed quality criterion. Make it explicit, then test whether the revision changes the artifacts as intended.

options.text: Assume the polished summaries show that the original skill meets the need
options.feedback: Readable prose is only one quality dimension. The repeated omission shows an important requirement is unmet.

options.text: Switch to unattended operation so repeated runs eventually include the questions
options.feedback: Repeated operation does not reliably repair an omitted requirement and can keep producing the same inadequate output.

options.text: Replace the test transcripts with easier ones before comparing the summaries
options.feedback: Easier inputs can conceal the problem. Evaluate whether the revised procedure meets the actual requirement on useful examples.
